completionSettings.completionHelp: What happens when an unpaid order is ready to hand over.
completionSettings.pressesOneHelp: This is better if you take the money as you hand the food over. You get just one button — “Mark paid & collected” — it records the payment and clears the order at the same time.
completionSettings.pressesTwoHelp: This is better if payment and handover happen at different times — someone pays at the truck, then collects when the order is ready. You get two buttons: first “Mark paid”, then “Collected” when they take the food.
